title: ExpertFeedback
description: Expert feedback input from ai.feedback.v1 RabbitMQ queue. KR-071: No PII. Aligned to training_feedback.v1.schema.json contract. Worker interface/contracts/expert_feedback.v1 vendored kopyasıyla `properties` + `required` düzeyinde EŞDEĞERDİR; bayt-özdeşlik BEKLENMEZ — vendored kopya `additionalProperties: false`, kanonik `unevaluatedProperties: false` idiomunu kullanır (bilinçli ve 9/9 şemada tutarlı; 2026-07-31'de ölçüldü). Doğrulama: tests/test_vendored_parity.py.

analysis_result_id.description: Analyzed result ID. Replaces legacy 'job_id' field.

expert_user_id.description: Anonymized expert identifier (no PII per KR-071). Replaces legacy 'expert_id' field.

confidence_in_correction.description: Expert confidence in their correction (0-1). Shown in worker_ssot.md:175.

training_grade.description: KR-029: Only A and B are exported for training

notes.description: Optional expert notes. Max 350 chars. XSS/shell injection chars blocked (worker_ssot.md:184-194). T2.3: control characters (U+0000 through U+001F including newlines/tabs and U+007F DEL) also rejected to prevent null-byte injection and log-injection (26_04_rapor SEC-02). Single-line UTF-8 only.

bulk_approval_id.description: KARAR-15: batch id shared by SEPARATE reviews the expert approved in one click (platform: BulkApproveRequest.review_ids, 5-50 reviews). AUDIT/GROUPING ONLY. NOT a cascade trigger: it says nothing about tile grouping, and treating its presence as 'fan this verdict out to group members' silently propagates one expert decision to tiles the expert never saw once the dedup path is live. Use `representative_tile_id` for that.

representative_tile_id.description: The tile whose expert verdict may be fanned out to the members of ITS similarity group (SimilarTileDeduplicator). Null = no group, no cascade. This is the ONLY cascade trigger; `bulk_approval_id` is a separate concept (see there). Explicit on purpose: the producer must state that a group exists, rather than a consumer inferring it from an unrelated field.

mask_correction.description: T1.3 Yol C — Expert correction shape for SEGMENTATION outputs (Yol B / Yol C polygon masks). Optional; legacy tile-rectangle producers (Yol A) emit null. Polygon correction granularity is per-Detection: an expert can ADD a missing polygon, REMOVE a wrong one, MODIFY boundary, or fully RE-MASK the tile. KARAR-15 bulk_approval continues to count tiles (not polygons) — this field carries the per-detection diff for grade A/B training export.

correction_type.description: What the expert changed relative to the model's detection.

corrected_polygon_geojson.description: Replacement / addition GeoJSON Geometry (EPSG:4326). Null when correction_type=polygon_removal.

corrected_class_id.description: Class id from config/crops/<crop>.yaml. May differ from the original detection's class_id when the expert reclassified the polygon.

pixel_bbox.description: Tile-local pixel bbox (origin top-left) for the corrected polygon. Mirrors tile_coordinates shape; preserved for UI overlay alignment when CRS metadata is unavailable.

job_id.description: DEPRECATED: Legacy field, use analysis_result_id. Accepted for backward compatibility during migration.

expert_id.description: DEPRECATED: Legacy field, use expert_user_id. Accepted for backward compatibility during migration.
